name: agentpickup
description: Buy online with a card or an agent payment, get a QR by email, collect in person.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @agentpickup/core && npm run build -w @agentpickup/server && npm run build -w @agentpickup/mcp
scripts.test: node --conditions=source --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/server/test/*.test.ts packages/mcp/test/*.test.ts apps/demo/test/*.test.ts
